Our 15 Most Reviewed Recipes of 2026

Updated: Oct 8, 2026 by Jen Wooster

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:01
Instaread

Our most-reviewed recipes offer a delicious look at the dishes readers have been loving most, from easy sides to comforting meals and sweet treats. Roasted radishes and rutabaga, creamy soups, chicken pot pie, scalloped potatoes, tomato sauce, zucchini, eggplant, gluten-free rolls, and even a special dog birthday cake bring plenty of crowd-approved variety.

Lemon and Herb Roasted Radishes

WANT TO SAVE THIS RECIPE?

I'll send it straight to your inbox. Plus you'll get great new recipes from me every week!

Roasting brings out the naturally sweet flavor of watermelon radishes, while lemon and parsley add a fresh, lively finish. This colorful side is quick enough for busy dinners and distinctive enough to earn a place in your regular rotation.
Get the Recipe: Bright Roasted Watermelon Radishes

Creamy Roasted Red Pepper Soup with Gouda

Sweet roasted red peppers and savory Gouda create a smooth, comforting vegetarian soup with plenty of rich flavor. It comes together quickly, making it a wonderful choice for an easy lunch or cozy dinner.
Get the Recipe: Creamy Roasted Red Pepper Soup with Gouda

Golden Parmesan-Baked Rutabaga

Tender rutabaga becomes a comforting gratin with savory Parmesan and fragrant fresh herbs. This easy vegetable side is especially lovely alongside a holiday roast or other special-occasion meal.
Get the Recipe: Golden Parmesan-Baked Rutabaga

Colorful Tanghulu Candied Fruit

Tanghulu turns fresh fruit into a glossy, crisp-coated treat inspired by a beloved Chinese street food. Strawberries, grapes, and other fruits make this playful snack especially fun for parties, celebrations, or a sweet afternoon treat.
Get the Recipe: Colorful Tanghulu Candied Fruit

The Golden, Comforting Dish Everyone is Raving About

Tender chicken and cozy pot pie flavors come together in this comforting recipe without gluten or dairy. It offers the nostalgic appeal of a classic comfort-food dinner while keeping the overall meal feeling light and wholesome.
Get the Recipe: Comforting Gluten-Free Dairy-Free Chicken Pot Pie

Festive Cranberry Raspberry Jello Salad

Tart cranberries and sweet raspberry gelatin create a colorful holiday side with a delightfully fruity flavor. Fresh fruit and crunchy walnuts add texture, making this nostalgic salad a cheerful addition to festive meals.
Get the Recipe: Festive Cranberry Raspberry Jello Salad

Light and Creamy Summer Squash Soup

Fresh yellow squash, onion, garlic, and herbs create a smooth soup that feels light yet satisfying. It is an easy way to enjoy summer produce in a refreshing bowl that works beautifully for lunch or a simple dinner.
Get the Recipe: Light and Creamy Summer Squash Soup

Bold Cajun Garlic Butter Sauce

Rich butter and bold Cajun seasoning give this versatile sauce a wonderfully savory kick. It is a flavorful finishing touch for seafood boils, steaks, dipping, and plenty of other favorite dishes.
Get the Recipe: Bold Cajun Garlic Butter Sauce

Easy Gluten-Free Royal Icing with Meringue Powder

This smooth royal icing makes decorating sugar cookies and gingerbread much easier without using egg whites. It is naturally gluten-free and dairy-free, making it a handy choice for festive baking projects and holiday cookie decorating.
Get the Recipe: Easy Gluten-Free Royal Icing with Meringue Powder

Classic San Marzano Tomato Sauce

Sweet San Marzano tomatoes create a rich, bright sauce with the simple character of classic Italian cooking. This naturally gluten-free staple is ready in about 30 minutes and works beautifully with pasta, pizza, and other favorite meals.
Get the Recipe: Classic San Marzano Tomato Sauce

Cheesy Gluten-Free Scalloped Potatoes with Roasted Garlic

Thinly sliced potatoes become tender and creamy beneath a layer of sharp white cheddar and mellow roasted garlic. With no flour needed, this naturally gluten-free side brings plenty of comforting richness to holiday and family dinners.
Get the Recipe: Cheesy Gluten-Free Scalloped Potatoes with Roasted Garlic

Crispy Parmesan-Roasted Zucchini and Squash

Tender zucchini and squash develop golden edges beneath a savory Parmesan topping in this easy vegetable side. Ready in about 20 minutes, it is a flavorful way to add more produce to busy weeknight meals.
Get the Recipe: Crispy Parmesan-Roasted Zucchini and Squash

Easy Oven-Roasted Eggplant Slices

These roasted eggplant slices develop tender centers and beautifully browned edges for a simple, versatile side dish. They pair easily with everything from pasta and grilled meats to grain bowls and Mediterranean-inspired meals.
Get the Recipe: Easy Oven-Roasted Eggplant Slices

Adorable Easy Dog Birthday Cake

This simple homemade cake gives your favorite canine companion a special birthday treat without requiring complicated baking equipment. Its easy preparation makes celebrating your pup feel fun and fuss-free.
Get the Recipe: Adorable Easy Dog Birthday Cake

Soft and Buttery Gluten-Free Crescent Rolls

These pillowy crescent rolls have a tender, buttery texture that makes them feel wonderfully indulgent despite being gluten-free. With a short hands-on preparation time, they are a delicious addition to holiday dinners, family meals, and special occasions.
Get the Recipe: Soft and Buttery Gluten-Free Crescent Rolls

Sweet and Savory Honey-Roasted Rutabaga

Roasting brings out the earthy sweetness of rutabaga while honey creates a delicious sweet-savory finish. Fragrant thyme complements the root vegetable beautifully, making this an easy side for weeknight dinners or holiday tables.
Get the Recipe: Sweet and Savory Honey-Roasted Rutabaga
